# Check — M0-a-01, consolidation round R1, closing check (lane check/M0-a-01-consolidate-close-1, flow-7, 2026-10-11)

**Verdict: FAIL, on one line.**

* **What passes.** All four findings N-1 – N-4 of `kernel-plan.md` §1.0 are applied and hold against their oracles
  (CONFIRMED). Every gate exits 0. landed:verify gives ok. The changed existing files differ from their before-images in
  comments only. No folder index or barrel export changed. 48 of 51 targeted mutants are red, and the 3 survivors are
  equivalent.
* **What fails.** One rewritten comment does not match the code. That is a blocker under this round's rule: "a comment
  that no longer matches the code is a blocker".

The check is `importsShared(file, name)` (copies.ts:38). `equivalence.test.ts` calls it in the table test "names every site the plan lists, each a copy in place or an import of the shared name" and in the N-4 test "each site's constant equals its home's, or the site imports the name". | Make the sentence name the code: "…which `importsShared()` checks (equivalence.test.ts's table test) in place of the comparison".
